name: Sinharaja Forest Reserve
description: Sinharaja is a dense patch of tropical rainforest in south-west Sri Lanka, the last sizeable stretch of the island's original, undisturbed forest. More than 60% of its trees grow nowhere else on Earth, and the canopy shelters many endemic birds, along with over half of the country's endemic mammals and butterflies. Look for rare frogs, reptiles and insects along its shaded trails.
